scope: Parent-balanced supervised angular-force guide on generated training states, then frozen conditional-MH sampling. No equilibrium training-data claim.
training_sampling: Uniform original parent, then uniform scored-state/eligible-leaf example within that parent. All graph-supported training proposals are eligible, including rejected local and exchange proposals.
target: r times the tangent projection of the COM-projected physical force/kT; cap its norm at100 for this proposal-regression loss.
cost_contract: No new physical calls during fitting; each learned method inherits all5564 training-preparation and4096 training-source queries. Development source512 and warm-up404 are common. Count all capped search attempts, neural/geometry time and physical queries separately.
stop_rule: Training MSE, capped validity and correctness tests are not scientific success. Require repeated benefit over strong physical and same-cap controls, then independent molecular conditions and distribution checks before claiming ICLR readiness.
